name: Welcome to North Brooke
source:
Welcome to North Brooke is a adult visual novel in which the main character is tasked with settling into a new town, meeting new people and seeking new experiences. Our protagonist will have to maneuver his way through tough situations and make good decisions in order to make the most out of his new surroundings. As well as having to settle into a new town our protagonist will be flung straight into brand new university and job where he will have to learn to keep up with his responsibilities as well as manage his social life. Will he crumble under the pressure or will he prosper in his new found popularity, we will have to wait and see.

[From [URL=https://rift-studios.itch.io/welcome-to-north-brooke]itch.io[/URL]]
translation:
《欢迎来到北布鲁克》是一部成人视觉小说，主角的任务是适应新城镇、结识新朋友并寻求新体验。我们的主角必须巧妙应对困境并做出正确的决定，才能充分利用新环境。除了必须定居在一个新城镇之外，我们的主角还将直接进入全新的大学和工作，在那里他必须学会履行自己的责任并管理自己的社交生活。他会在压力下崩溃，还是会在新发现的人气中蓬勃发展，我们将不得不拭目以待。

[来自 [URL=https://rift-studios.itch.io/welcome-to-north-brooke]itch.io[/URL]]
